samples.where: 3.1 3. Data and DEFINE DATA / The DEFINE DATA block
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #NAME (A20)
1 #AGE (N3)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 'GRACE HOPPER' TO #NAME
MOVE 79 TO #AGE
WRITE #NAME #AGE
END

END-DEFINE

samples.where: 3.3 3. Data and DEFINE DATA / Fields have a width when printed
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #A (A10)
1 #N (N5)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 'LEFT' TO #A
MOVE 42 TO #N
WRITE '[' #A ']'
WRITE '[' #N ']'
END

samples.where: 4.1 4. Assignment and computation / MOVE, the assignment operator, and COMPUTE
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #PRICE (N7.2)
1 #QTY (I4)
1 #TOTAL (N9.2)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 19.99 TO #PRICE
#QTY := 3
COMPUTE #TOTAL = #PRICE * #QTY
WRITE 'Total:' #TOTAL
END

samples.where: 4.2 4. Assignment and computation / Exact decimals, not floating point
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #R (N5.2)
END-DEFINE
COMPUTE #R = 0.1 + 0.2
WRITE 'Exactly:' #R
END

samples.where: 4.3 4. Assignment and computation / Truncation is the default; ROUNDED opts in
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #CUT (N3.1)
1 #ROUND (N3.1)
END-DEFINE
COMPUTE #CUT = 1.29
COMPUTE ROUNDED #ROUND = 1.29
WRITE 'Truncated:' #CUT
WRITE 'Rounded:  ' #ROUND
END

samples.where: 4.4 4. Assignment and computation / The arithmetic verbs
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #N (N7.2)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 100 TO #N
ADD 50 TO #N
WRITE 'After ADD:     ' #N
SUBTRACT 25 FROM #N
WRITE 'After SUBTRACT:' #N
DIVIDE 5 INTO #N
WRITE 'After DIVIDE:  ' #N
END

samples.where: 5.1 5. Input and decisions / INPUT reads a value
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #NAME (A20)
END-DEFINE
INPUT 'What is your name?' #NAME
WRITE 'Hello,' #NAME
END

samples.where: 5.2 5. Input and decisions / IF, ELSE, END-IF
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #AGE (N3)
END-DEFINE
INPUT 'How many years of service?' #AGE
IF #AGE >= 25
WRITE 'Eligible for the long service award.'
ELSE
WRITE 'Not yet eligible.'
END-IF
END

samples.where: 5.3 5. Input and decisions / DECIDE FOR: a ladder of conditions
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #SCORE (N3)
1 #GRADE (A1)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 87 TO #SCORE
DECIDE FOR FIRST CONDITION
WHEN #SCORE >= 90
MOVE 'A' TO #GRADE
WHEN #SCORE >= 80
MOVE 'B' TO #GRADE
WHEN NONE
MOVE 'F' TO #GRADE
END-DECIDE
WRITE 'Score' #SCORE 'is grade' #GRADE
END

samples.where: 5.4 5. Input and decisions / DECIDE ON: branching on one value
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #DAY (N1)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 6 TO #DAY
DECIDE ON FIRST VALUE OF #DAY
VALUE 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
WRITE 'A working day.'
VALUE 6, 7
WRITE 'The weekend.'
NONE VALUE
WRITE 'Not a day of the week.'
END-DECIDE
END

samples.where: 6.1 6. WRITE and DISPLAY / WRITE is free-format
samples.source:

1 #CITY (A20)
1 #POP (N8)

MOVE 'DERBY' TO #CITY
MOVE 261000 TO #POP

samples.where: 6.2 6. WRITE and DISPLAY / DISPLAY builds a report
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #I (I4)
1 #PRODUCT (A12)
1 #QTY (N4)
END-DEFINE
MOVE 'WIDGET' TO #PRODUCT
FOR #I = 1 TO 3
COMPUTE #QTY = #I * 10
DISPLAY #PRODUCT #QTY
END-FOR
END

samples.where: 7.2 7. Loops / REPEAT and ESCAPE BOTTOM
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #N (N5)
END-DEFINE
REPEAT
ADD 1 TO #N
WRITE 'Count is' #N
IF #N >= 4
ESCAPE BOTTOM
END-IF
END-REPEAT
WRITE 'Out of the loop.'
END

samples.where: 8.2 8. Reading the database / Declare a view, then READ it
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 FIRST-NAME
2 CITY
END-DEFINE
READ EMPLOYEES-VIEW BY NAME
DISPLAY NAME FIRST-NAME CITY
END-READ
END

samples.where: 8.3 8. Reading the database / FIND searches
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 COUNTRY
2 SALARY
END-DEFINE
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH COUNTRY = 'USA' SORTED BY NAME WHERE SALARY > 45000
DISPLAY *COUNTER NAME SALARY
END-FIND
WRITE 'The search matched' *NUMBER 'records before the WHERE filter.'
END

samples.where: 8.4 8. Reading the database / When nothing matches
samples.source:

END-DEFINE
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH CITY = 'ATLANTIS'
IF NO RECORDS FOUND

END-NOREC
WRITE NAME
END-FIND
END

samples.where: 9.1 9. Changing the database / STORE adds a record
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 PERSONNEL-ID
2 NAME
2 FIRST-NAME
2 CITY
2 COUNTRY
2 SALARY
END-DEFINE
MOVE '99999999' TO PERSONNEL-ID
MOVE 'TURING' TO NAME
MOVE 'ALAN' TO FIRST-NAME
MOVE 'LONDON' TO CITY
MOVE 'UK' TO COUNTRY
MOVE 71000 TO SALARY
STORE EMPLOYEES-VIEW
END TRANSACTION
READ EMPLOYEES-VIEW BY NAME
DISPLAY NAME CITY SALARY
END-READ
END

samples.where: 9.2 9. Changing the database / UPDATE changes the record you are on
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 SALARY
END-DEFINE
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH NAME = 'GARRET'
WRITE 'Before:' SALARY
COMPUTE SALARY = SALARY * 1.10
UPDATE
END-FIND
END TRANSACTION
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH NAME = 'GARRET'
WRITE 'After: ' SALARY
END-FIND
END

samples.where: 9.3 9. Changing the database / Forget END TRANSACTION and lose the work
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 SALARY
END-DEFINE
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH NAME = 'GARRET'
COMPUTE SALARY = 999999
UPDATE
WRITE 'In this run the field says:' SALARY
END-FIND
WRITE 'But nothing was committed, so nothing persists.'
END

samples.where: 9.4 9. Changing the database / DELETE and BACKOUT
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
END-DEFINE
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH NAME = 'JONES'
DELETE
END-FIND
WRITE 'Deleted, but not committed. Now backing out:'
BACKOUT TRANSACTION
READ EMPLOYEES-VIEW BY NAME
WRITE NAME
END-READ
END

samples.where: 9.5 9. Changing the database / Capstone: put it all together
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 COUNTRY
2 SALARY
1 #TOTAL (P11)
1 #RAISE (N9.2)
1 #GRADE (A8)
END-DEFINE
WRITE 'STAFF REVIEW'
HISTOGRAM EMPLOYEES-VIEW FOR COUNTRY
WRITE COUNTRY 'has' *NUMBER 'staff'
END-HISTOGRAM
READ EMPLOYEES-VIEW BY NAME
ADD SALARY TO #TOTAL
DECIDE FOR FIRST CONDITION
WHEN SALARY >= 60000
MOVE 'SENIOR' TO #GRADE
WHEN SALARY >= 40000
MOVE 'MID' TO #GRADE
WHEN NONE
MOVE 'JUNIOR' TO #GRADE
END-DECIDE
DISPLAY NAME COUNTRY SALARY #GRADE
END-READ
WRITE 'Total payroll:' #TOTAL
COMPUTE ROUNDED #RAISE = #TOTAL * 0.035
WRITE 'Raise budget: ' #RAISE
END

samples.where: 11.2 11. Subroutines / An inline subroutine shares the program data
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 SALARY
1 #TOTAL (P11)
1 #COUNT (I4)
1 #AVERAGE (N9.2)
END-DEFINE
PERFORM GATHER
PERFORM SHOW-TOTALS
DEFINE SUBROUTINE GATHER
READ EMPLOYEES-VIEW
ADD SALARY TO #TOTAL
ADD 1 TO #COUNT
END-READ
END-SUBROUTINE
DEFINE SUBROUTINE SHOW-TOTALS
COMPUTE ROUNDED #AVERAGE = #TOTAL / #COUNT
WRITE 'Employees:' #COUNT
WRITE 'Average:  ' #AVERAGE
END-SUBROUTINE
END

samples.where: 14.1 14. Maps: the green screen / DEFINE MAP lays out a screen
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #NAME (A20)
1 #DEPT (A6)
END-DEFINE
DEFINE MAP EMPENTRY
TEXT 2 25 'EMPLOYEE MAINTENANCE'
TEXT 4 25 '===================='
FIELD 7 10 'Name:' #NAME
FIELD 9 10 'Dept:' #DEPT
TEXT 22 10 'Enter to confirm'
END-MAP
INPUT USING MAP EMPENTRY
WRITE 'You entered' #NAME 'in department' #DEPT
END

samples.where: 14.2 14. Maps: the green screen / Attribute bytes make fields behave differently
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #USER (A10)
1 #PIN (A4)
1 #AMOUNT (N7)
END-DEFINE
DEFINE MAP SIGN-ON
TEXT 3 28 'SECURE TRANSFER'
FIELD 8 10 'User:  ' #USER (AD=I)
FIELD 10 10 'PIN:   ' #PIN (AD=N)
FIELD 12 10 'Amount:' #AMOUNT
END-MAP
INPUT USING MAP SIGN-ON
WRITE 'User' #USER 'moved' #AMOUNT
WRITE 'The PIN was never displayed on screen.'
END

samples.where: 14.3 14. Maps: the green screen / PF keys tell the program what the operator wanted
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 #NAME (A20)
END-DEFINE
DEFINE MAP CONFIRM
TEXT 2 25 'ADD AN EMPLOYEE'
FIELD 6 10 'Name:' #NAME
TEXT 22 10 'Enter to save, PF3 to cancel'
END-MAP
INPUT USING MAP CONFIRM
IF *PF-KEY = 'PF3'
WRITE 'Cancelled. Nothing was saved.'
ELSE
WRITE 'Would save' #NAME
END-IF
END

samples.where: 15.1 15. Capstone: a maintenance program / Search and report
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 CITY
2 COUNTRY
2 SALARY
1 #WHERE (A3)
1 #HOWMANY (N3)
1 #TOTAL (P11)
END-DEFINE
DEFINE MAP SEARCH
TEXT 2 25 'STAFF ENQUIRY'
FIELD 6 10 'Country code:' #WHERE
TEXT 22 10 'Enter to search'
END-MAP
INPUT USING MAP SEARCH
CALLNAT 'STAFFCNT' #WHERE #HOWMANY
IF #HOWMANY = 0
WRITE 'No staff found in' #WHERE
ELSE
PERFORM LIST-THEM
END-IF
DEFINE SUBROUTINE LIST-THEM
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH COUNTRY = #WHERE SORTED BY NAME
DISPLAY NAME CITY SALARY
ADD SALARY TO #TOTAL
END-FIND
WRITE 'Headcount:' #HOWMANY
WRITE 'Payroll:  ' #TOTAL
END-SUBROUTINE
END

samples.where: 15.2 15. Capstone: a maintenance program / A validated update, committed
samples.source:
DEFINE DATA LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 NAME
2 SALARY
1 #WHO (A20)
1 #RISE (N5)
END-DEFINE
DEFINE MAP RAISEMAP
TEXT 2 25 'AWARD A RAISE'
FIELD 6 10 'Employee:' #WHO
FIELD 8 10 'Amount:  ' #RISE
TEXT 22 10 'Try GARRET and 3000'
END-MAP
INPUT USING MAP RAISEMAP
IF #RISE = 0
REINPUT 'Enter an amount greater than zero.'
END-IF
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH NAME = #WHO
IF NO RECORDS FOUND
WRITE 'No employee called' #WHO
ESCAPE BOTTOM
END-NOREC
WRITE 'Before:' SALARY
ADD #RISE TO SALARY
UPDATE
END-FIND
END TRANSACTION
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH NAME = #WHO
WRITE 'After: ' SALARY
END-FIND
END

library.name: DOUBLEIT
library.source:
DEFINE DATA PARAMETER
1 #IN (N5)
1 #OUT (N7)
END-DEFINE
COMPUTE #OUT = #IN * 2
END

library.name: STAFFCNT
library.source:
DEFINE DATA
PARAMETER
1 #COUNTRY (A3)
1 #HOWMANY (N3)
LOCAL
1 EMPLOYEES-VIEW VIEW OF EMPLOYEES
2 COUNTRY
END-DEFINE
RESET #HOWMANY
FIND EMPLOYEES-VIEW WITH COUNTRY = #COUNTRY
ADD 1 TO #HOWMANY
END-FIND
END
